summary: As of 2026-08-22 the current CesiumJS stable is 1.144.0 (npm publish 2026-08-04; Apache-2.0; Node >=22; WebGL2 default since 1.102 with WebGL1 fallback; WebGPU is only 'longer term, explore' on Cesium's roadmap). Measured Build/Cesium/Cesium.js is 5.97 MB minified / 1.73 MB gzip. Native vector-tile support finally exists: MVTDataProvider (1.142, marked experimental) loads MVT as 3D Tiles with Cesium3DTileStyle styling and picking, and 1.144 drapes clamped vector polygons/polylines on terrain; GeoJsonPrimitive (1.142) bypasses the entity layer. Viewer defaults (baseLayer = ImageryLayer.fromWorldImagery, geocoder, baseLayerPicker) all hit Cesium ion; an ion-free Viewer needs baseLayer/geocoder:false/baseLayerPicker:false and a non-ion terrain provider. Ion-free imagery that works from plain UrlTemplateImageryProvider: OSM (policy forbids heavy/production use, no SLA), Esri Static Basemap Tiles (token required, 2M tiles/mo free then $0.15/1k, 'Powered by Esri' + data credits), MapTiler (key required; Free plan non-commercial + logo; Flex $30/mo), Mapbox Raster Tiles (750k/mo free then $0.25/1k; text + logo attribution). Cesium ion Community plan is free but personal/non-commercial (paid plan required above $50K revenue/funding), 5 GB storage, 15 GB/mo streaming, 1,000 Global Imagery sessions, 1,000 Google 3D root tiles; ion logo must be displayed; Bing imagery via ion persists until Microsoft's 2028-06-30 enterprise cutoff, with Google Maps 2D Tiles added as replacement. Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles direct: https://tile.googleapis.com/v1/3dtiles/root.json?key=, Enterprise SKU, 1,000 free root-tile requests/mo then $6.00 per 1,000; caching prohibited beyond HTTP cache headers; Google logo + per-tile copyright required; createGooglePhotorealistic3DTileset falls back to ion asset 2275207 when no key is set. Open terrain: AWS Terrarium tiles (s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod, z0-15, 3DEP-derived in WA, USGS attribution) are raster-RGB and need conversion to quantized-mesh (ctb quantized-mesh fork via tum-gis Docker, or ion Terrain Tiler fusing with Cesium World Terrain, whose US West Coast resolution is 50 cm). WA-specific 3D inputs: WA DNR Lidar Portal (DEM/hillshade/point clouds; described as 'publicly available', no license text found) and USGS 3DEP EPT on AWS (usgs-lidar-public, public domain); no open photogrammetric mesh for WA was found. Cloud-native delivery stack that is current and permissively licensed: COG (OGC 21-026) + TiTiler 2.2.1/rio-tiler 9.4.3, PMTiles v3 + tippecanoe 2.79.0/Planetiler 0.10.2, Martin 1.14.0 (PostGIS/PMTiles/MBTiles/GeoParquet) or pg_tileserv 1.0.11, Zarr 3.3.0 + Kerchunk 0.2.10/VirtualiZarr 2.7.3, GeoParquet 2.0.0 (pending OGC). React: Resium 1.25.0 (2026-08-07, peer cesium 1.x, react >=18.2) is alive; vite-plugin-cesium 1.2.23 last published 2024-08-06 and Cesium's own Vite example uses vite-plugin-static-copy + define instead.

providers.name: CesiumJS imagery, vector and time-dynamic ingestion APIs
providers.authority: Cesium GS, Inc. (CesiumJS reference docs / source)

access.mechanism: UrlTemplateImageryProvider, OpenStreetMapImageryProvider, WebMapTileServiceImageryProvider (times/clock), WebMapServiceImageryProvider (times/clock), ImageryLayer (show/alpha/splitDirection/colorToAlpha), GeoJsonDataSource/CzmlDataSource, GeoJsonPrimitive + BufferPrimitiveCollections (1.142), MVTDataProvider.fromUrl (1.142, experimental), Cesium3DTileset, CesiumTerrainProvider.fromUrl (quantized-mesh/heightmap), Credit/CreditDisplay
access.auth: None in the API; whatever the upstream tile service requires

providers.temporal_resolution: WMTS/WMS time dimension: TimeIntervalCollection (e.g. ISO8601 '2025-01-01/2025-09-01/P5D') drives a {Time} placeholder from the Viewer clock
providers.missing_data_semantics: Imagery tile 404s surface via ImageryLayer.errorEvent; no built-in nodata masking beyond colorToAlpha
providers.quality_flags: MVTDataProvider 'is not final and is subject to change without Cesium's standard deprecation policy'
limitations: UrlTemplateImageryProvider placeholders: {z},{x},{y},{reverseX},{reverseY},{reverseZ},{s},{width},{height},{westDegrees}..{northDegrees},{westProjected}.., plus customTags; tilingScheme defaults to Web Mercator — set GeographicTilingScheme for WGS84 tiles (e.g. TiTiler WGS1984Quad).

Default OpenStreetMapImageryProvider credit string is the stale 'MapQuest, Open Street Map and contributors, CC-BY-SA' — override credit with '© OpenStreetMap contributors' (ODbL) to satisfy the OSM policy.

MVTDataProvider.fromUrl(url,{minZoom:0,maxZoom:14,extent,featureIdProperty}) builds a Cesium3DTileset at runtime; per-feature styling via Cesium3DTileStyle and picking via getProperty; 1.144 added draping of clamped vector polygons/polylines onto terrain with screen-space-constant width. Geometry coverage and clamp behavior need hands-on validation (INFERENCE).

Before 1.142 there was no native MVT path; community providers (hongfaqiu/kikitte MVTImageryProvider, davenquinn/cesium-vector-provider) rasterize MVT to imagery. Cesium has no 'MapboxVectorTile' imagery provider.

GeoJsonDataSource is entity-based (clampToGround, stroke/fill/strokeWidth/markerSymbol/credit; GeoJSON+TopoJSON+simplestyle); for large datasets use GeoJsonPrimitive (1.142) which loads directly into BufferPrimitiveCollections 'for significantly improved performance'.

Time-dynamic imagery: WMTS/WMS providers accept options.times (TimeIntervalCollection whose data object supplies dimension values such as Time) and options.clock (required when times is set). The alternative 'pre-create next layer with alpha 0, then swap' pattern is a community/TerriaJS practice, not an API (INFERENCE).

Provider credits appear in the 'Data attribution' lightbox unless Credit(html, showOnScreen=true); providers like Mapbox/Esri/MapTiler/Google require on-screen attribution and logos, so construct on-screen Credits and add logos via your own HTML.
CesiumTerrainProvider.fromUrl expects layer.json + {z}/{x}/{y}.terrain (quantized-mesh) or heightmap tiles; options requestVertexNormals/requestWaterMask/requestMetadata.

evidence.claim: UrlTemplateImageryProvider placeholders and options (credit, subdomains, minimumLevel, maximumLevel, rectangle, tilingScheme default Web Mercator, customTags)

providers.name: Cesium ion (Community plan, global content, terms)

access.auth: ion access token (Ion.defaultAccessToken); per-asset endpoint calls
access.rate_limits: Community: 5 GB storage, 15 GB/month streaming, 1,000 Global Imagery (Bing/Google/Azure) sessions/month, 1,000 Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles root tiles/month, 50,000 geocodes/month, 20 gigapixels reality modeling. Exceeding quota: 'your account will continue to work without interruption' and Cesium contacts you.

providers.cadence: Cesium World Terrain and OSM Buildings updated by Cesium on unpublished schedules; imagery partner-driven

OSM Buildings: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution required (auto-applied by Cesium software); underlying license ODbL (INFERENCE — license name not on the page).

providers.name: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles (Map Tiles API) via CesiumJS

access.mechanism: 3D Tiles tileset at https://tile.googleapis.com/v1/3dtiles/root.json?key=YOUR_API_KEY; CesiumJS createGooglePhotorealistic3DTileset({key|GoogleMaps.defaultApiKey, onlyUsingWithGoogleGeocoder:true}); with no key it falls back to Cesium ion asset 2275207
access.auth: Google Maps Platform API key (Map Tiles API enabled) or Cesium ion token
access.rate_limits: Billing counts root tileset requests; one root request enables ~3 hours of child tile requests; 'Tile requests for Photorealistic 3D Tiles don't impact your daily quota'. Enterprise SKU: 1,000 free events/month, then $6.00 per 1,000 (cap-100,000), $5.10 (100,001-500,000), $4.20 (500,001-1,000,000), $3.30 (1,000,001-5,000,000), $2.40 (5,000,000+).

providers.cadence: Google 'regularly updates and adds imagery' (no schedule)
providers.spatial_resolution: City-scale photogrammetric mesh; coverage page marks US Map Tiles 2D/3D available; Seattle-area coverage is city-level, rural Skagit/Nooksack headwaters likely not covered (INFERENCE)
providers.missing_data_semantics: Outside coverage the tileset has no content; Cesium docs recommend globe:false when using it as the global base
providers.licensing: Map Tiles API policies: 'you must not pre-fetch, index, store, or cache any Content except under the limited conditions stated'; HTTP Cache-Control/ETag honored. Must show Google Maps logo (16-19 dp, clear space) and per-tile copyright text in full; no overlapping the Google logo with other logos. Prohibited: image analysis, machine interpretation, object detection, geodata extraction/resale, offline use.

Default credit in Cesium is a Google logo image served from assets.ion.cesium.com shown on screen (Credit(..., true)).

Cesium docs state CesiumJS 1.91+ is required; Cesium sets cacheBytes 1.5 GiB and maximumCacheOverflowBytes 1 GiB defaults for this tileset.
Via ion: Community plan allows 1,000 root tiles/month.
